title: visionOS build rejected by TestFlight due to incompatible Info.plist entries
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: `v4.8.dev6.mono.official` [8898c2b3d]

Haven't tried older versions. I quick glance at the history of [`editor_export_platform_apple_embedded.cpp`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/editor/export/editor_export_platform_apple_embedded.cpp) makes me think this problem has existed since visionOS support was first introduced. I suspect that TestFlight uploads have not yet been attempted, at least not without manually fixing the Info.plist file.



### System information

Godot v4.8.dev6.mono - macOS Unknown (27.0.0) - Multi-window, 3 monitors (5120x2880 @ 60.00 Hz, 3024x1964 @ 120.00 Hz, 5120x2880 @ 60.00 Hz) - Metal (Mobile) - integrated Apple M5 Pro (Apple9) - Apple M5 Pro (18 threads) - 64.00 GiB memory - CoreAudio (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When running `altool` (Xcode CLI utility) to upload a visionOS build to TestFlight, the following error is shown.

```
2026-09-24 16:26:38.671 ERROR: [ContentDelivery.Uploader.6000002C8040]
=======================================
UPLOAD FAILED with 1 error
=======================================
2026-09-24 16:26:38.672 ERROR: [altool.6000002C8040] Validation failed (409)
This bundle is invalid. The key UIRequiredDeviceCapabilities contains value
'iphone-ipad-minimum-performance-a12' which is incompatible with the
MinimumOSVersion value of '26.0'. (ID: 2fef3a6d-4b76-4395-843f-da50ba42c648)
   NSUnderlyingError : Validation failed (-19241) This bundle is invalid. The
key UIRequiredDeviceCapabilities contains value
'iphone-ipad-minimum-performance-a12' which is incompatible with the
MinimumOSVersion value of '26.0'.
      status : 409
      detail : This bundle is invalid. The key UIRequiredDeviceCapabilities
contains value 'iphone-ipad-minimum-performance-a12' which is incompatible with
the MinimumOSVersion value of '26.0'.
      id : 2fef3a6d-4b76-4395-843f-da50ba42c648
      code : STATE_ERROR.VALIDATION_ERROR
      title : Validation failed
   iris-code : STATE_ERROR.VALIDATION_ERROR
Failed to upload package.
TestFlight upload failed.
```

It seems that `iphone-ipad-minimum-performance-a12` is enforced by the Apple Embedded export template:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/30caae98b79ec7e75e5f893290a51b4048eaa141/editor/export/editor_export_platform_apple_embedded.cpp#L538-L540

Probably it shouldn't even be an option for visionOS. Same for `iphone-performance-gaming-tier`:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/30caae98b79ec7e75e5f893290a51b4048eaa141/editor/export/editor_export_platform_apple_embedded.cpp#L329-L332

According to [UIRequiredDeviceCapabilities](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/bundleresources/information-property-list/uirequireddevicecapabilities), `iphone-ipad-minimum-performance-a12` and `iphone-performance-gaming-tier` are not available on visionOS.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Export and empty, default project for visionOS.
2. Try to upload it to TestFlight.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
